items.item: `Sources/Command Runner/Command.Main.swift`: any error thrown from `run()` prints "Error: ..."
items.reason: File is now Sources/Command Runner/Command.swift. A Command.Error from run() (cast from C.Failure) prints Diagnostic.message (skipped when empty) and exits with Diagnostic.exitCode; other errors keep 'Error: ...' and exit 1. Redirection tests pin exit(code: 3) and validationFailed -> 64 via the helper executable.

Tokens carry no argv index (Argument.Token lives in swift-atoms/swift-argument), so the visitor maps the token's byte range back to the argv element it came from. Consecutive empty argv elements share a byte offset; such a token maps to the first of them. missingPositional reports argvIndex = argv.count and byteOffset = total argv bytes (the end). Visitors built with the tokens-only init have no argv and still report 0.

notes: Behaviour change only: Command.main exit codes for a Command.Error thrown from run() (was always 1). Existing helper executable gained two phrases ('exit-3', 'invalid') used by the new tests.
